planet.plain_summary: This looks like a planet about 1.1 times the size of Jupiter that circles its star every 8.9 days.
key_facts: Estimated from how much starlight is blocked and the star's size.
Earth-size < 1.25, super-Earth < 2, Neptune-size < 6, Jupiter-size < 25 Earth radii.
Time for one trip around the star.
1 AU is the distance from the Earth to the Sun.
Rough temperature if the planet reflects 30% of the starlight and spreads the heat evenly. Degrees Celsius = kelvin minus 273.
How much of the star's light is blocked during each dip.
